snippet.description:
Class 4 English Chapter 7 focuses on Important Inventions and is aligned with the PCTB (Punjab Curriculum and Textbook Board) syllabus for primary students across Pakistan.

In this video lesson, we explore fascinating inventions that changed human life. Students will learn about key historical inventions, understand their significance, and develop vocabulary related to innovation and discovery. This chapter helps Class 4 learners improve their reading comprehension, vocabulary skills, and general knowledge.

What You Will Learn:
- Overview of important inventions and inventors
- Vocabulary related to inventions and technology
- Comprehension of the chapter content
- Writing and speaking skills about inventions
- Critical thinking about how inventions impact society

This lesson is designed for Class 4 students following the national curriculum in Pakistan, including Federal Board (FBISE), Punjab boards (BISE Lahore, Rawalpindi, Multan, Faisalabad, and others), Sindh, KPK, Balochistan, and AJK boards. Whether you're a student preparing for assessments, a parent supporting your child's education, or a teacher looking for classroom resources, this video provides clear explanations and engaging content.

The chapter builds foundational English language skills essential for academic success in primary education. Understanding important inventions also enhances general knowledge, which supports overall learning development.

Watch this complete lesson to master Chapter 7 and strengthen your English proficiency. Don't forget to like, subscribe, and comment with any questions or topics you'd like us to cover next!

snippet.description:
Spending 2–3 hours reading the newspaper every day? Sonia Ma'am explains how UPSC aspirants can make newspaper reading more efficient by setting a strict 45-minute limit.

Learn how to prioritise important headlines, read the Explained page carefully, avoid spending too much time on political and world news, and scan the newspaper first before deciding what deserves your attention.

Build a focused newspaper-reading habit and save more time for your UPSC preparation.
